title: 2022 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: The Math Team designed a logo shaped like a multiplication symbol, shown below on a grid of \(1\)-inch squares. What is the area of the logo in square inches?

solutions.text:
The logo is made from \(5\) congruent tilted squares. Each tilted square has both diagonals of length \(2\), so its area is \(\frac{2\cdot2}{2}=2\) square inches.

The total area is \(5\cdot2=10\).

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Break the logo into congruent tilted squares
Each tilted square is half of a \(2\) by \(2\) grid square
